calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jun-30-2015 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Name Change.
Dept. 514, Judge: Charles Crompton, Clerk: Yolanda Mazariegos, CSR: Mitch Lyon, #6840
Petitioner Brian Phanichkarn, father of minor present in court.

Petitioner sworn and examined.
Nikki Elise Nisby mother of minor is deceased.
Proof of Publication on file.
Yvonne Stainthorpe, Candace Nisby and Jon Nisby (relatives of deceased minor's mother present) on the record stated their objections to the Name Change of minor.
After objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing. The Court granted Petition.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.
The court grants the petition for Change of Name of minor from Nathaniel Kaili Nisby to Nathan Oudomdet Phanichkarn.
Decree Changing Name signed in open court.
